R3.quadratic_action_TT: S_2 = (1/(4K)) int dt d^3x a^3 [ (1/4) gamma_ij' gamma^ij' - (1/(4a^2)) d_k gamma_ij d^k gamma^ij + H (gamma_ij gamma^ij)' + (1/2)(3H^2 + Lambda) gamma_ij gamma^ij ]
R3.beta_dependence: none at quadratic order (delta theta = 0 for TT at first order; only a total derivative remains)
R3.mass_terms: (3H^2+Lambda) and H(gamma^2)' terms; they reduce to a total derivative on the background 3H^2=Lambda and do not enter the dispersion relation

R4.theta_first_order_with_trace: 3 d_t(tr)/(2N)  (nonzero: the vanishing is specific to trace-free perturbations)
R4.extrinsic_curvature: K_ij = d_t h_ij/(2N) for a static background with zero shift
R4.Pi_reason: every operator in the P-sector is O(P^1) (tadpole) or O(P^2); with Pbar=0 no first-order stress exists, and delta theta=0 removes the only scalar source
R4.caveat_branch: if the static background carries Pbar != 0 (the tadpole P^i D_i ln N forces |D ln N| = u/(1-u/a0), so Pbar != 0 whenever grad N != 0), the sector has a background anisotropic stress and delta Pi != 0 at first order is possible; then Phi/Psi != 1 and its value needs the background Pbar(r) profile
